```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = TRUE, warning = TRUE)
source("00_setup.R")
library(openxlsx)
```

For every study participant in the `r my_run` run, list the top-ranked genes
and their variants:

* if an ESTABLISHED (manually confirmed) gene of that participant is ranked
  within the top 5 ranks (`top_n`), list every gene ranked above it plus the gene itself;
* otherwise list the top 5 ranked genes.

Ranks are handled as in `02_read_filter_save.Rmd`: one rank per gene (best
inheritance mode), then PAPSS2/FAM20C removed and the genes below them moved
up. No score cutoffs are applied.

## Settings and inputs

```{r inputs}
top_n <- 5

data_filter <- read_study_filter()
genes_john  <- read_manual_genes(data_filter)

# Intronic carriers (see 00_setup.R) are left out: their variant isn't scored by Exomiser
intronic_vcf_ids <- data_filter$VCF_FILE_ID[data_filter$SKSC_ID %in% intronic_carriers]
message("Excluding intronic carriers: ", paste(intronic_vcf_ids, collapse = ", "))

raw_vars <- read_exomiser_run(my_run) %>%
  filter(Participant_ID %in% data_filter$VCF_FILE_ID,
         !Participant_ID %in% intronic_vcf_ids) %>%
  rename(EXOMISER_RANK = RANK)

message("Study participants in ", my_run, ": ", n_distinct(raw_vars$Participant_ID))
```

## Gene ranks

```{r gene-ranks}
gene_ranks <- raw_vars %>%
  mutate(RANK = EXOMISER_RANK) %>%
  best_rank_per_gene() %>%
  maybe_remove_genes() %>%
  select(Participant_ID, GENE_SYMBOL, MOI, EXOMISER_RANK, RANK) %>%
  left_join(mutate(genes_john, ESTABLISHED = TRUE), by = c("Participant_ID", "GENE_SYMBOL")) %>%
  mutate(ESTABLISHED = coalesce(ESTABLISHED, FALSE))
```

## Rank cutoff per participant

```{r cutoffs}
# Best-ranked ESTABLISHED gene per participant (if any was ranked by Exomiser)
best_established <- gene_ranks %>%
  filter(ESTABLISHED) %>%
  arrange(RANK) %>%
  distinct(Participant_ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(Participant_ID, ESTABLISHED_GENE = GENE_SYMBOL, ESTABLISHED_RANK = RANK)

participant_summary <- data_filter %>%
  filter(VCF_FILE_ID %in% raw_vars$Participant_ID) %>%
  select(SKSC_ID, Participant_ID = VCF_FILE_ID, CaseOrControl) %>%
  left_join(best_established, by = "Participant_ID") %>%
  mutate(
    HAS_CONFIRMED_GENE = Participant_ID %in% genes_john$Participant_ID,
    STATUS = case_when(
      ESTABLISHED_RANK <= top_n ~ paste("Established gene in top", top_n),
      !is.na(ESTABLISHED_RANK)  ~ paste("Established gene ranked below", top_n),
      HAS_CONFIRMED_GENE        ~ "Established gene not ranked by Exomiser",
      TRUE                      ~ "No established gene"
    ),
    RANK_CUTOFF = if_else(!is.na(ESTABLISHED_RANK) & ESTABLISHED_RANK <= top_n,
                          ESTABLISHED_RANK, top_n)
  ) %>%
  select(-HAS_CONFIRMED_GENE)

count(participant_summary, STATUS) %>% knitr::kable()
```

## Selected genes and their variants

```{r select}
selected_genes <- gene_ranks %>%
  inner_join(select(participant_summary, Participant_ID, RANK_CUTOFF), by = "Participant_ID") %>%
  filter(RANK <= RANK_CUTOFF)

# All variants of each selected gene at its best-ranked inheritance mode
variant_cols <- c("CONTRIBUTING_VARIANT", "HGVS", "FUNCTIONAL_CLASS", "GENOTYPE",
                  "CONTIG", "START", "END", "REF", "ALT", "RS_ID",
                  "EXOMISER_GENE_COMBINED_SCORE", "EXOMISER_GENE_PHENO_SCORE",
                  "EXOMISER_GENE_VARIANT_SCORE", "EXOMISER_VARIANT_SCORE",
                  "EXOMISER_ACMG_CLASSIFICATION", "EXOMISER_ACMG_EVIDENCE",
                  "CLINVAR_PRIMARY_INTERPRETATION", "CLINVAR_STAR_RATING", "MAX_FREQ")

top_variants <- selected_genes %>%
  inner_join(raw_vars, by = c("Participant_ID", "GENE_SYMBOL", "MOI", "EXOMISER_RANK")) %>%
  left_join(select(participant_summary, Participant_ID, SKSC_ID, CaseOrControl), by = "Participant_ID") %>%
  select(SKSC_ID, Participant_ID, CaseOrControl, RANK, EXOMISER_RANK, GENE_SYMBOL,
         ESTABLISHED, MOI, any_of(variant_cols)) %>%
  arrange(SKSC_ID, RANK, GENE_SYMBOL)

message("Rows: ", nrow(top_variants), " variants in ",
        nrow(distinct(top_variants, Participant_ID, GENE_SYMBOL)), " gene / participant pairs")

participant_summary <- participant_summary %>%
  left_join(count(selected_genes, Participant_ID, name = "N_GENES_LISTED"), by = "Participant_ID") %>%
  arrange(SKSC_ID)
```

## Write Excel file

```{r excel}
notes <- tibble(Note = c(
  paste0("Exomiser ", exomiser_version, ", run ", my_run, "; study participants only (IDs_for_study_filtering, FILTERED = FALSE)."),
  paste0("Intronic carriers excluded: ", paste(intronic_carriers, collapse = ", "), "."),
  "RANK: one rank per gene (best inheritance mode), with PAPSS2 and FAM20C removed and the genes below them moved up.",
  "EXOMISER_RANK: Exomiser's original rank for that gene / inheritance mode.",
  paste0("If an ESTABLISHED (manually confirmed) gene is ranked within the top ", top_n,
         ", all genes ranked above it plus the gene itself are listed; otherwise the top ", top_n, " genes."),
  "Ranks can have gaps (a gene's other inheritance modes and removed genes free their rank), so fewer genes than the cutoff may be listed.",
  "One row per variant: genes with several variants (e.g. compound heterozygous) span several rows.",
  "No Exomiser score cutoffs applied."
))

wb <- createWorkbook()
header_style      <- createStyle(textDecoration = "bold", fgFill = "#D9D9D9", border = "bottom")
established_style <- createStyle(fgFill = "#FCE4D6")

add_sheet <- function(name, data, col_width = "auto") {
  addWorksheet(wb, name)
  writeData(wb, name, data, headerStyle = header_style, withFilter = ncol(data) > 1)
  freezePane(wb, name, firstRow = TRUE)
  setColWidths(wb, name, cols = seq_along(data), widths = col_width)
}

add_sheet("Top ranked variants", top_variants)
addStyle(wb, "Top ranked variants", established_style,
         rows = which(top_variants$ESTABLISHED) + 1, cols = seq_along(top_variants),
         gridExpand = TRUE, stack = TRUE)
add_sheet("Per participant", participant_summary)
add_sheet("Notes", notes, col_width = 120)

excel_file <- file.path(results_dir, paste0("Top_ranked_genes_per_participant_", my_run, file_suffix, ".xlsx"))
saveWorkbook(wb, excel_file, overwrite = TRUE)
message("Written: ", excel_file)
```
